title: The Prime Tread Wheel: whitepaper, Lean 4 formalization, and solver-free certificates
description: Release bundle for the Prime Tread Wheel. Contains: (1) WHITEPAPER.md, the full monograph — a wheel growing by one unit per layer (period T(m) = m(m+1)/2) carrying the counting numbers, with the stagger-field theorems, the certified covering-number bracket d(1500) in [42, 45] (both ends solver-free), the 48-rotation Local Rigidity witness, and the Erdős #7 solver-free certificates; (2) lean_wheel/, an 83-theorem, zero-sorry Lean 4 + mathlib formalization (axiom footprints subset of {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}); (3) verify/, solver-free exact-integer Python verifiers (standard library only); (4) certificates/, the JSON certificate artifacts. See WHITEPAPER.md §14 for the itemized independent-convergence demarcation (Tucker, Zenodo 2026-09-23, credited on his items; the spiral, guarantee-zone wedge, solver-free stack, and formalization claimed here).
